free_tier.stated: A model whose ID ends in :free is free: requests cost nothing and work with any balance. The Free tier allows 5 requests per minute, 150 per hour, 500,000 uncached input tokens per hour, 100,000 output tokens per hour, 3,000,000 input tokens per day and 1,000,000 output tokens per day. Every request to a free model is collected for data handling.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

chaining: the free model list is the scarce link, and it is a fixed set rather than the whole catalogue

limits.value: Free tier: 5 requests/minute, 150/hour, 500,000 uncached input tokens/hour, 100,000 output tokens/hour, 3,000,000 input tokens/day, 1,000,000 output tokens/day
an unpublished concurrency cap fails a request at once with 429 concurrency_limit_exceeded

identity_cost.detail: a network account; the page states no card for the free models

reliability_note: free requests are logged for data handling, so the allowance is paid for with the prompt text

evidence.proved: free models cost nothing and work with any balance, with separate limits and every request collected
evidence.quote: A model whose ID ends in `:free` is free: requests cost nothing and work with any balance. Free models have their own limits — see [Tiers and limits](https://docs.fortytwo.network/docs/limits.md). Every request to a free model is collected — see [Data handling](https://docs.fortytwo.network/docs/data-handling.md#free-models). Fortytwo can change or withdraw a free model at any time — see [Terms of Service](https://docs.fortytwo.network/legal/terms-of-service.md).

evidence.proved: the Free tier publishes exact request and token limits

binding_note: the Free tier is rate-limited on all four windows; the 5 requests/minute and 1,000,000 output tokens/day bind before any other constraint
